report.summary:
Patient P-D011 (34, commercial high-deductible plan, deductible not met, no transport benefit) was seen today V-D011. Active problems: T2DM with hyperglycemia (E11.65) and obesity (E66.9). Medication cost concern: semaglutide pen 0.5 mg weekly, tier 4, $250/month copay, with a 14-day refill gap — metformin ER is affordable ($4/month, no gap). Social-needs screener (2026-10-26) indicates a transportation need ("no" to having transportation). Home tract 17031062000 has high no-vehicle share (47.6%) but dense transit (88 stops within 800 m). Scheduled appointments at the clinic (appt:1 2026-09-08 16:30, appt:2 2026-10-26 16:30) could not be transit-checked because no facility location is on file.

Med-cost options: Clinic Rx Fund (short-term copay help for current patients), Community Pharmacy Assistance (help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer programs), Rx Bridge Program (same-day help for approved patients; pre-approval page requests MRN and medication list — do not send identifiers outside the clinic). Transport options: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification by phone, decisions up to 21 days). Senior Shuttle West (age 60+) and Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid members) are not eligible for this patient; Rx Bridge Program listed for transport is only for already-approved patients.
